verdict.rationale: Better Stack is an observability and incident platform where scheduled automations are a plausible feature, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no capability for users to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. Heartbeat monitoring of CRON jobs (docs-6/16) only watches jobs that run elsewhere. On-call rotation schedules (docs-12/24) and monitor check intervals (docs-37) are adjacent features, not user-defined recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
